headline: Streaming guide JustWatch launches its own streaming service
summary: JustWatch, a streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own streaming service with free, ad-supported movies and shows, a $3.99-per-month ad-free tier, movie rentals, and a lifetime ad-free subscription option.
